title: Lost update: a payment webhook and the cart-expiry worker clobber one order
notes: Two independent traces read orders:8812 before either wrote it. The webhook commits AUTHORIZED at +260ms; the expiry worker read PENDING at +190ms and commits CANCELLED at +330ms, so its stale write wins. The capture request at +560ms is correct code refusing to capture a cancelled order.
assertions: assert final != CORRUPT_VALUE, f'lost update still wins: {final} must not be {CORRUPT_VALUE}'
assert final in (EXPECTED_VALUE, 'CAPTURED'), f'unexpected final state: {final}'
assert int(field(db, 'orders', PRIMARY_KEY, 'webhook_applications', 0)) <= 1, 'the webhook applied this order twice'
assert int(field(db, 'wallet_credits', PRIMARY_KEY, 'credits', 0)) <= 1, 'the payment moved more than once'
duplicate_assertions: assert applied == 1, f'webhook applied {applied} times for a single event id'
